items.name: Burette
items.use: Delivers a variable, accurately measured volume of solution (here, the acid). Read to the nearest 0.05 cm³.

items.name: Pipette (25.0 cm³) with filler
items.use: Measures exactly 25.0 cm³ of a solution. Always use a pipette filler, never your mouth.

items.name: Conical flask
items.use: Holds the solution being titrated. Its shape lets you swirl without spilling.

items.name: White tile
items.use: Placed under the flask so the colour change is easy to see.

items.name: Funnel
items.use: Used to fill the burette, then removed before titrating.

items.name: Wash bottle
items.use: Contains distilled water for rinsing apparatus and washing the sides of the flask.

items.name: Beaker of acid
items.use: Holds the acid used to rinse and fill the burette.

items.name: Beaker of alkali
items.use: Holds the alkali that the pipette measures.

items.name: Indicator bottle
items.use: A few drops show the end point by a sharp colour change.

tasks.task: Measure exactly 25.0 cm³ of alkali into the flask.
tasks.why: Only the pipette measures a fixed volume this accurately.

tasks.task: Add acid gradually and measure how much was added.
tasks.why: The burette delivers a variable volume that you can read to 0.05 cm³.

tasks.task: Make the colour change easy to see.
tasks.why: A white tile under the flask shows the colour clearly.
Use a funnel to fill, then remove it before titrating.

tasks.task: Rinse the conical flask before use.
tasks.why: The flask is rinsed with distilled water only.

tasks.task: Hold the solution while you swirl it during the titration.
tasks.why: A conical flask lets you swirl without splashing.

tasks.task: Show the end point of the reaction.
tasks.why: Two or three drops of indicator change colour at the end point.
